title: Trappers Hill Lodges & Campground

services.name: Glamping Cabin
services.desc: Tucked beneath the trees, our Trappers Cabins offer a cozy stay for those who appreciate a more rustic experience. These heated cabins have two layouts, one king bed or two separate double beds, a table and chairs, and enough room to gather, rest, or plan your next day in the mountains. Though simpler than our glamping cabins, they provide just the right balance of comfort. Perfect for families, friends, or small groups looking to stay close to nature. Outside, each cabin includes a private fire pit, picnic table, and space to unwind beneath the stars. Whether you’re sharing stories around the fire or setting out early for a hike or off-road ride, the Trappers Cabin makes a great basecamp.
